description:
Simulate a Q&A session moderation scenario. You have two Firefox windows open side-by-side. The LEFT window is for the Moderator (Alice). The RIGHT window is for the Guest (Bob).

1. In the LEFT window, join the meeting 'TownHallQandA' as 'Moderator Alice'.
2. In the RIGHT window, join the same meeting as 'Citizen Bob'.
3. In the RIGHT window (Bob), click the 'Raise Hand' button to signal a question.
4. Verify the raised hand icon appears in the Moderator's view (Left).
5. As the Moderator (LEFT window), use the participant menu to LOWER/DISMISS Bob's hand. Do NOT lower the hand using Bob's window.
6. Ensure the hand icon disappears.
